title: Specify lead reconciliation envelope
description: Validates the request and response envelopes of the agent-led lead-reconciliation step per RFC-29 D2. `kind: request` is returned by `specrun plan propose --dry-run --format json`: a flat catalog of raw, unmerged `(source-key, lead-id)` leads read 1:1 from `discovery.md`, plus targets and optional workspace projects. Each lead the kernel proved is the same work across sources by exact id or exact alias carries a `group` block naming the locked group it belongs to; open leads carry no `group`. `kind: response` is the agent's grouping consumed by `specrun plan propose --from`: `concepts[]` partitions the surveyed leads exactly once, while `slices[]` references those concepts and binds each `(concept-id, target)` pair to one target and optional project. The kernel validates this shape, enforces the global partition and locked-group invariants, carries each locked member's proven `match-basis` forward, derives unique `plan.yaml.slices[]` names from optional `name` or concept/target fallback, and writes through the existing plan writers; it never auto-merges on its own heuristic — cross-source unification of open leads is the agent's grouping in the response. Closed top-level shape: unknown fields are rejected.

targetRef.description: Target adapter identifier, e.g. `omnia@v1` or `contracts@v1`. Mirrors `plan.schema.json` slice `target` pattern.

projectRef.description: One registered project from `registry.yaml`, surfaced into the request so the agent can bind each response slice to a project by matching the slice's concept and target against the project's `target` and `description`.

name.description: Registry project name; the value the kernel writes to `plan.yaml.slices[].project`.

target.description: The project's registered target adapter. A response slice may only bind to a project whose registered `target` equals the slice's `target`.

description.description: Single-sentence domain characterisation used by the agent when more than one project shares a target.

lockedMatchBasis.description: Kernel-computed proof basis for a locked group binding: the same `lead-id` (`exact-id`) or an exact alias (`exact-alias`) surfaced across source keys. The agent never authors these; the kernel carries them forward onto the response's locked members.

leadGroup.description: Request-side binding of this catalog row to one locked reconciliation group — a set of `(source-key, lead-id)` rows the kernel proved denote the same work by exact id or alias. Open leads omit `group`. A group is defined implicitly by the rows that share `group-id`; there is no separate group index.

group-id.description: Canonical lead id of the locked group this catalog row belongs to (the shared `lead-id`, or the canonical id for an alias match). The kernel reads a group's members by filtering `leads[]` on this value.

match-basis.description: Kernel-computed proof for this row's locked-group membership. Per-row, so one locked group may mix `exact-id` and `exact-alias` rows.

lead-id.description: Discovery lead id surfaced by this source binding. Identity is the `(source-key, lead-id)` pair; `lead-id` is not unique across `leads[]` when multiple sources surface the same id.

summary.description: One-line per-source summary from this source's survey of the lead. This is the signal the agent groups open leads on.

aliases.description: Optional aliases from the surveyed Lead, the basis for exact-alias locked groups.

projects.description: Registry topology in workspace mode: every entry from `registry.yaml#/projects[]` (name + target + description). Absent in single-repo mode.

leads.description: Flat lead catalog: one row per raw `(source-key, lead-id)` lead, read 1:1 from `discovery.md` (no expansion or cross-source merge). Rows the kernel proved are the same work across sources carry a `group` block; open leads omit it. The `lead-id` field repeats across rows when multiple sources surface the same discovery id.

source-key.description: Plan source binding key; must match a request catalog row.

lead-id.description: Discovery lead id; with `source-key`, must match a request catalog row.

match-basis.description: Set to `semantic` for an open lead the agent merged into this concept by cross-source judgment; surfaced for operator review at Gate 1. Omitted for members of a locked group — the kernel carries their proven `exact-id` / `exact-alias` basis forward during projection. The agent cannot author an `exact-*` basis, so it cannot forge or downgrade a locked match.

tentative.description: Agent-flagged low-confidence semantic membership; surfaced for operator review at Gate 1.

concept-id.description: Concept id for a unit of work. Response `slices[]` entries reference this id; it is not necessarily the derived plan slice name.

rationale.description: Agent's reason for the concept membership; rendered into change.md for operator review, most useful on semantic merges.

concept-id.description: Concept id of a declared `concepts[]` entry. May repeat across response slices when the same concept fans out to multiple targets.

name.description: Optional explicit plan slice name for this `(concept-id, target)` row. When omitted, the kernel derives a unique slice name deterministically.

target.description: Exactly one target per response slice (one slice per `(concept-id, target)` pair, per D5). The same concept may appear under more than one target.

depends-on.description: Derived slice names this row depends on (not concept ids). Each name must resolve to a projected `plan.yaml.slices[]` entry.

project.description: Registry project this slice binds to, chosen by the agent from the request's `projects[]`. Required on every slice in workspace mode; omitted in single-repo mode.

rationale.description: Agent's reason for target or project binding when the choice is not obvious; rendered into change.md for operator review.
